items.label: Elamipretide × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Strongest human signal in corpus: meta-analysis documents accelerated approval for muscle-strength improvement in Barth syndrome (42794697) and a case report shows multi-domain gains (LVEF to 50%, Ross class IV→I, HRQoL; 42415111, n=1). Phase 3 (NCT05162768, N=102), phase-4 confirmation (NCT07531251, N=48) and phase 1/2 (NCT05168774, N=20) are active with no posted results, so the negative phase-3 cap is NOT triggered; cardiac disease modification remains explicitly unconfirmed (42794697) and the approval endpoint is an intermediate one (NCT07531251). SoC is supportive care only (SoC map); approved SC peptide with established safety.

items.label: Mitochondria-targeted therapy (class-level: SGLT2i/ranolazine/MitoQ/SS-31/NAD precursors) × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Only significant quantitative human data in the corpus: pooled meta-analysis reports LVEF SMD 0.42 vs control, NYHA improvement RR 2.38, all-cause mortality RR 0.62 and HF-hospitalization RR 0.60 (42440741). Confidence is limited because it pools heterogeneous agents (42495453) against a non-GDMT-matched control (SoC map), and the remaining class-level records are narrative without pooled estimates (40845481, 41595638, 42273289). No trial with posted results among these refs; strong GDMT SoC caps unmet need; repurposed oral small molecules support translatability.

items.label: Restorin NR × aging
items.rationale: Single animal study (n=11): significantly higher circulating NAD+ than comparators and statistically equivalent to a 3-fold higher NR/NMN dose (42582917) — a surrogate biomarker only, no health outcome. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base, total capped at 4.0. No disease-modifying standard for aging; oral small molecule.

items.label: Idebenone / rAAV2-2-ND4 gene therapy × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Review-level positive signals: partial visual recovery with early idebenone treatment and rAAV2/2-ND4 improvement in both eyes after unilateral injection (42535808), non-significant and review-only. Idebenone is the current LHON SoC (SoC map), limiting unmet need. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base, total capped at 4.0.

items.label: Elamipretide + NAC (antioxidant/redox) × retinitis pigmentosa
items.rationale: Phase-2-stage review proposing extracellular mtDNA as a candidate pharmacodynamic endpoint only — no efficacy results reported (42792149). RP has no approved therapy, so unmet need is high; elamipretide safety is established via its Barth syndrome approval (42794697). <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base, total capped at 4.0.

items.label: Nicotinamide riboside × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Significant preclinical benefit in 661W R340H cells (apoptosis, OCR, ROS, CAT/SOD/GSSG restored) and MT-ND4 mice (pattern ERG ameliorated) (10.21203/rs.3.rs-8295635/v1); no human trial in the record. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base, total capped at 4.0.

items.label: Nicotinamide riboside × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Single registered phase-2 trial (N=34, adult-onset mitochondrial myopathy) with no posted results (NCT05590468); per the registry-only rule this raises pipeline_momentum only, never evidence quality or effect direction. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base, total capped at 4.0. Supportive-care-only SoC (SoC map).

items.label: NAD+ supplementation × Parkinson's disease
items.rationale: Review shows circulating NAD+ increases (surrogate) but clinical benefits remain 'variable and context-dependent' (42489969). No disease-modifying PD therapy exists in the SoC map context. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: NR082 (gene therapy) × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Phase-3 double-masked sham-controlled RCT (N=95, 2024; NCT07406854) plus phase-2 single-arm study (N=12, 2023; NCT05293626) are active with no posted results — strong momentum but zero posted efficacy or safety data. AAV gene-therapy delivery risk remains unresolved; idebenone SoC limits unmet need (SoC map).

items.label: Urolithin A × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Two preclinical studies with consistent positive but non-significant signals: diastolic function, remodeling and contraction/relaxation kinetics in a multihit HFpEF animal model plus human engineered heart tissue (42616901); diastolic dysfunction, hypertrophy, fibrosis and mitochondrial respiration in an animal study (42432192). Zero human efficacy data; strong GDMT SoC caps unmet need (SoC map).

items.label: Mitochondria-targeted strategies (MitoQ/Skulachev ions/elamipretide, class reviews) × primary mitochondrial diseases
items.rationale: Mixed-to-negative: broadly acting mitochondrial interventions have 'repeatedly failed in sporadic disease', with the strongest translational signal only where dysfunction is genetically anchored (42782782); autologous germline mitochondrial energy transfer failed to show clinical benefit and only maternal spindle transfer outcomes are 'promising' but unconfirmed (39066614); narrative review with no quantitative effect (41594657). Supportive-care-only SoC (SoC map).

items.label: SkQ1 × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: In vitro only: SkQ1 reduced ROS production, stabilized mitochondrial membranes and downregulated PINK1 (39335534); non-significant, no human data, no trials. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: Luteolin × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Single preclinical in vitro/in vivo study: luteolin alleviated TMT-induced myocardial injury, exerted anti-ferroptosis effects and restored mitochondrial fusion/mitophagy proteins (42013553); no human data. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: Nicotinamide riboside × chronic heart failure
items.rationale: Single registered phase-2 RCT (N=60) with no posted results on cardiac dysfunction, muscle injury or functional capacity (NCT05732051); no preclinical support in the record; strong GDMT SoC caps unmet need (SoC map). <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: Methylene blue + MitoQ × skeletal aging (age-related bone loss)
items.rationale: Negative in vivo finding: no effect on age-related bone loss at cortical mid-diaphysis, trabecular distal femur or L5 in 18-month-old mice; only in vitro antioxidant benefits (38535998). Neutral/harmful-tier signal with no clinical follow-up. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: NFS-02 (gene therapy) × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy
items.rationale: Single-arm phase-1 trial (N=11) with no safety or visual-acuity results reported in the record (NCT05820152); AAV delivery risk unresolved; idebenone SoC limits unmet need (SoC map). <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

items.label: Mitochondria-targeted drugs (class) × neurodegenerative diseases
items.rationale: Narrative mechanism review only — no study results reported (41677699); no trial in the record. High unmet need (no disease-modifying standard in the SoC map) cannot compensate for the absence of any efficacy data. <2 ref_ids: thin evidence base.

leaders: Elamipretide × primary mitochondrial diseases (total 6.8) — the only direction ≥6: approved muscle-strength endpoint (42794697), corroborating case report (42415111) and an active phase-3/4 trial ladder (NCT05162768, NCT07531251) in a supportive-care-only disease (SoC map)
outsiders: Nicotinamide riboside × chronic heart failure (2.9): only a registered phase-2 with no posted results and no preclinical support in the record (NCT05732051); strong GDMT leaves little unmet need (SoC map)
Methylene blue + MitoQ × skeletal aging (2.9): the sole study is a negative in vivo finding — no effect on age-related bone loss at any of four bone sites (38535998)
NFS-02 × Leber hereditary optic neuropathy (2.9): single-arm phase-1 with no results reported (NCT05820152) and unresolved AAV delivery risk
Mitochondria-targeted drugs × neurodegenerative diseases (2.9): mechanism-only narrative review with zero study results and no trials (41677699)
caveats: Several records coded 'meta-analysis' are actually narrative reviews without pooled estimates (41594657, 42782782, 42273289, 41677699, 42489969), and 42794697 is a 2026 'meta-analysis' that documents a regulatory approval; evidence quality was scored at the true design level.

The only significant human data point (42440741) pools heterogeneous agents against a control that is not GDMT-matched (SoC map) — indirectness lowers confidence in a mechanism-specific causal claim; it is also inconsistently coded 'phase 1 early' despite pooled meta-analysis estimates.

All eight registry-linked trials show no posted results (NCT05168774, NCT05162768, NCT07531251, NCT05820152, NCT07406854, NCT05293626, NCT05590468, NCT05732051); per rubric rule 3 these were credited to pipeline_momentum only, never to evidence quality or effect direction.

No negative phase-3 replication failure exists in the corpus: elamipretide's phase-3 (NCT05162768) and phase-4 confirmation (NCT07531251) are result-pending, so the negative phase-3 effect_direction cap (max 3) was not triggered for any direction — efficacy beyond muscle strength is currently unproven, not disproven (42794697).

Positive signals lean on surrogate/intermediate endpoints: muscle strength is explicitly an intermediate clinical endpoint (NCT07531251); NAD+ levels (42582917, 42489969); extracellular mtDNA is only a proposed biomarker (42792149).

11 of 17 directions rest on <2 distinct ref_ids (thin-evidence cap applied, total ≤4); a single n=1 case report contributes to the elamipretide direction (42415111); and no head-to-head mito-targeted vs SoC comparison (GDMT or idebenone) exists — 42535808 is the closest human data point.
